system.description: There is conviction of spirit, there is unshakable will, and there is just plain being ornery — you fall into the last category. For one point, you're set in your ways but a convincing argument can turn you around. For two points, you're a regular mule and nothing short of catastrophe changes your mind. For three points, you'll defend your conviction to Hell's door and kick it in to argue with the Devil himself. Most often taken by warriors.
system.source: Clanbook: Salubri (Dark Ages), Chapter Four: The Powers of the Righteous
